relations.rationale: Dara being in the same group as Rosa is independent of whether Rosa shares a group with Tess.
Study group membership has no bearing on physical race positioning.

If Dara is in the same group as Rosa, and if Rosa is not in the same group as Tess (implied elsewhere), this makes it more likely Dara is also not with Tess, but on its own A alone doesn't establish that; still there's a plausible transitive support.
Study group membership is unrelated to race finishing order.
A weather/announcement detail doesn't imply anything about the crowd's movement to corrals, though both are pre-race scene details.
The sun breaking through at the five-minute warning has no bearing on Uma's arrival time earlier that day.
Everyone moving to corrals doesn't specifically imply Quinn glancing at a clipboard.
Moving toward corrals is a precursor consistent with the crowd later surging forward at the horn, supporting the sequence of events.
Rosa not sharing a group with Tess doesn't directly determine whether Dara shares a group with Tess.
Quinn glancing at a clipboard has no bearing on Rosa's finishing position relative to Tess.
Uma's early arrival doesn't relate to Dara's finish time or emotional state.
Arriving early doesn't necessarily correlate with finishing in the middle of the pack, these are separate aspects of performance.
Uma's early arrival doesn't inherently imply she cheered for others afterward.
Adjusting shoelaces is a pre-race action unrelated to positioning near taller runners.
Tess adjusting her shoelaces before the race has no bearing on laughter echoing at the finish area later.

Standing near the front with taller runners suggests a stronger starting position, which could support Rosa finishing ahead of Tess if Rosa was not in that front group, but this claim is about Tess's position not Rosa's, so the link is weak.
Dara's study group relationship with Tess has no bearing on Rosa's race finish relative to Tess.
The crowd surging forward as the horn sounds directly supports the onset of running, consistent with sneakers thudding rhythmically.
The crowd surging forward at the horn is a general race-start event and doesn't specifically indicate Rosa's finishing position relative to Tess.
The crowd surging forward at the start doesn't determine Uma's specific finishing position in the pack.
